AND( AND( NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c,'Entertainment Services'), OR( IM_Booked_Date__c < today(), ISBLANK(IM_Booked_Date__c) ) ), $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Sales_IMTN', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
